title: STM32 sensor hub with a Linux IIO driver
summary: An STM32 Nucleo sensor hub feeding a Raspberry Pi 4, with an MSA311 accelerometer and an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor. The target deliverable is a Linux IIO kernel driver for the hub; the driver is not written yet.
highlights: Done so far: the bare-metal foundation on the STM32 — reset path, vector table, HAL init, clock configuration and GPIO.
Sensors: MSA311 accelerometer and HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, read by the STM32 and passed to the Pi 4.
Target, not done: a Linux IIO kernel driver on the Pi that exposes the hub's sensor data through the IIO subsystem.

details.heading: Status
details.body: In progress. The IIO driver is a target, not a finished result.
